summary: Disney reported Q2 FY2026 earnings on May 6 before market open. New CEO Josh D'Amaro (formerly head of Disney Experiences) led first earnings call. Adjusted EPS $1.57 (beat est. $1.49), revenue $25.17B (beat est. $24.83B). Streaming operating income +88% YoY. Experiences division posted record fiscal Q2 revenues. Disney+ central to D'Amaro's forward strategy. Big Thunder Mountain Railroad reopened at Magic Kingdom. Mandalorian & Grogu film premieres May 22. Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Muppets opens May 26.
